mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_posts WHERE category = #{category}
SELECT p.*, u.name AS createdByName FROM tbl_posts p JOIN tbl_users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.category = 'N' ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT p.*, u.name AS createdByName FROM tbl_posts p JOIN tbl_users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_comments (post_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW());
